caseName: North Star Steel Co. v. Thomas
caseNameFull: North Star Steel Co. v. Thomas and Crown Cork & Seal Co., Inc. v. United Steelworkers of America, AFL-CIO-CLC

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 513 U. S. 1072.] Motion of petitioner Crown Cork & Seal Co., Inc., for divided argument denied. Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted.
